title: Streambound latency decomposition snapshotboard
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Build a snapshotboard that makes it easy for SREs and platform engineers to compare p50/p95/p99 latency across model families and routes with an explicit split for streaming vs non-streaming I/O modes. The board will surface correlated error rates and a quick link to representative traces (trace hooks). Goals: 1) enable fast diagnosis of tail regressions by route/model + io-mode, 2) provide SLO-aligned views for oncall, and 3) keep cardinality low enough to be queryable for 1h/24h/7d windows.
acceptance_criteria: Board shows p50/p95/p99 for model family x route for both streaming and non-streaming requests
Latency panels can be filtered by time window (1h, 24h, 7d) and by model tag (quantized, fp16, int8)
Clicking a cohort opens a trace sample list populated via trace hook links
Panels include correlated error-rate sparkline, failed token ratios, and request shape distribution
Queries are performant (<5s) for 1h window with current prometheus/metrics pipeline and documented in the runbook
updates: 2025-02-19: Kickoff meeting with SRE, Runtime, and Product. Agreed on primary dimensions: model_family, model_version, route, io_mode (streaming|sync), request_shape_cohort.
2025-02-22: Prototype queries evaluated. Decided to use histogram_quantile on OTLP histograms for p50/p95/p99 to avoid cardinality explosion from summary metrics.
2025-02-24: Spike showed high cardinality when including model_version. Agreed to default to model_family in top-level panels and expose model_version via a modal drilldown.
2025-02-26: Design mock reviewed by PM (Lina Cho) — suggestion to add a left-hand cohort selector for request shape (short, medium, long). Implemented in mock v2.
2025-02-28: Metric pipeline change merged: enable OTLP histogram buckets for servepath latency and attach io_mode tag at ingestion (PR: github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/412).

2025-03-01: Trace hook implementation merged to make sample traces available from board (PR: github.com/redwood/serve-runtime/pull/221). Hook returns pre-sampled spans and a pointer to the full trace in Jaeger.

2025-03-02: First real-data dashboard created in Grafana staging. Early review: p99 differences between streaming and sync visible for certain long-context conversations; need to add server-side KV cache hit-rate as an annotation.
notes: Tradeoffs discussed: histogram buckets give accurate quantiles but increase cardinality; mitigated by limiting tags to model_family and route and using modal drilldowns for model_version.
We considered separate SLI per io_mode vs a combined SLI with breakdown panels; choosing both: combined SLI for alerts and split panels for oncall investigation.
Alerting impact: will propose a new SLO (route-level p95 for sync, p95 for streaming) after we gather baseline for 2 weeks.
Follow-up: add KV cache hit-rate and batching size annotations to help correlate tail spikes to cache misses or small-batch effects.
